description: This file defines the ItemGroupController class, which manages a collection of NoteViewController and FileViewController instances, handling creation, closing, and observer notifications within a web application context.

classes.name: ItemGroupController
classes.description: Manages a group of item controllers (notes and files), providing methods to create, close, and observe changes in the active item controller.

methods.name: deinit
methods.description: Cleans up the controller, removing observers and clearing item controllers.

methods.name: createItemController
methods.description: Creates a new item controller (note or file) based on provided context, initializes it, and updates observers.

methods.name: closeItemController
methods.description: Deinitializes and removes a specific item controller, optionally notifying observers.

methods.name: closeActiveItemController
methods.description: Closes the currently active item controller.

methods.name: closeAllItemControllers
methods.description: Closes all item controllers managed by this class.

methods.name: addActiveControllerChangeObserver
methods.description: Adds an observer callback for changes to the active controller, returns a function to remove the observer.

methods.name: notifyObservers
methods.description: Notifies all registered observers about the current active controller.
